_help: Claude (Anthropic) writes the prospect's replies and scores the call; ElevenLabs speaks the prospect's voice, and OpenAI transcribes what the rep says (Chrome gives the live captions). The 'prospect', 'scorer' and 'refusal_fallback' blocks apply to Claude.

stt._help: Accurate speech-to-text for what the rep says, used when NEXT_PUBLIC_STT_PROVIDER=openai in .env.local (needs OPENAI_API_KEY). Chrome still gives the live captions and spots when you stop talking; each turn is then re-transcribed from the recording. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe is cheaper and quicker but a little less accurate than gpt-4o-transcribe.
stt.prompt: This is a UK business phone call. A salesperson from a company called mutherboard, a monday.com partner, is talking to a prospect about project management, CRM and workflow software. Transcribe exactly what was said, word for word: keep filler words such as um, uh, erm, you know and false starts, and do not tidy up the speech.

tts._help: The prospect's voice comes from ElevenLabs (see the 'elevenlabs' block). speed is the pace (ElevenLabs allows 0.7 to 1.2). accent.uk_percent is the share of prospects with a British accent; the rest are American. moods are the labels the AI uses to show how the prospect feels; mood_speed nudges the pace for each. speak_mode: whole | first_then_rest | sentences.

moods.distracted: flat, distracted, only half paying attention

elevenlabs._help: Used when TTS_BACKEND=elevenlabs and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY are set in .env.local. voices: ElevenLabs voice IDs, grouped by accent then gender. Leave a list empty to let the app pick a matching voice from your account automatically (run npm run elevenlabs:voices to see what you have, then paste favourites here). voice_settings are the baseline; moods and personalities nudge stability (lower = more emotional and varied) and style (higher = more animated). Voice speed comes from tts.speed (ElevenLabs allows 0.7 to 1.2).

prospect.note: To fall back to Haiku if latency is too high: set model to claude-haiku-4-5 and thinking to none.

tidy.note: After a call, a fast model adds punctuation and capitals to what the rep said (words are never changed) before scoring. Set enabled to false to skip.

refusal_fallback.note: Server-side fallback: if a safety classifier declines a request, the API retries it on another model. Set enabled to false to turn off.
